what: Plan treats revise failure as nonzero rc, but helper reports failed-no-patch, failed-validation, and failed-apply via REVISE_STATUS while exiting 0
scenario_or_breakage: A failed waterfall is treated as success, PLAN_HASH_AFTER_REVISE is recorded, and the loop may converge or hit cap with accepted findings unapplied
suggested_fix: Parse revise stdout and require REVISE_STATUS=ok; treat any other REVISE_STATUS as LOOP_STATUS=revision-failed, and update tests to stub status as well as rc

what: Plan disallows plan-review/round-N/revise publishing, but the revise helper writes exactly that subtree
scenario_or_breakage: Every successful auto-apply creates plan-review/round-N/revise/*, then design-log-publish.sh fails closed on nested unexpected files
suggested_fix: Update revise-plan-with-waterfall.sh and its md sibling to write forensics under DESIGN_TMPDIR/revise/round-N, or allow a constrained nested revise allowlist in design-log-publish.sh; make the plan choose one concrete contract

what: Outer-loop pseudocode has no tally-error branch before accepted-count, revision, and convergence logic
scenario_or_breakage: If tally fails before accepted-plan-findings.md is truncated, stale findings from a prior round can be revised again or counted as convergence/cap evidence
suggested_fix: After each round, branch on TALLY_PLAN_REVIEW_STATUS=tally-error before snapshot/revise/convergence; emit KVs that let SKILL.md roll back review-round-count.txt and do not consume stale accepted artifacts

what: Main-agent vote rerun is left unchanged, so tally defaults findings-classification-out to round-1
scenario_or_breakage: In internal round 2+, main-agent adjudication overwrites or misplaces the classification TSV and the round snapshot no longer matches the round that needed main-agent voting
suggested_fix: Update the main-agent-vote-required path to pass --findings-classification-out "$DESIGN_TMPDIR/plan-review/round-$ROUNDS_COMPLETED/findings-classification.tsv" and define whether post-main-agent accepted findings are auto-applied or handled by Gate B

what: The plan promises backward-compatible single-pass complete behavior, but the new pseudocode has no reachable complete path once auto-apply/cap/converged logic runs
scenario_or_breakage: Existing callers/tests that omit --round-cap can see converged or cap-hit and plan revision side effects despite the documented compatibility contract
suggested_fix: Introduce an explicit legacy_single_pass mode when --round-cap is omitted, or remove the compatibility promise and update all tests/docs/callers to the new status and auto-apply semantics

what: The plan creates scripts/test-design-multi-round-integration.sh but does not list Makefile as an updated file
scenario_or_breakage: New integration coverage is not run by make lint/test-harness shards, so the cross-script regression harness can silently rot
suggested_fix: Add Makefile to the plan with a phony test-design-multi-round-integration target and shard wiring; update docs/linting.md if target docs are expected

what: Refactor plan does not reset the current global _dedup_failed per internal round
scenario_or_breakage: A single dedup failure in round 1 can mark later clean rounds degraded, breaking convergence streaks and forcing unnecessary cap-hit runs
suggested_fix: Move _dedup_failed initialization inside _run_plan_review_round before dedup runs, and add a regression where only the first round dedup fails
